final: WITH station_avgs AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_usage) AS avg_usage FROM station_avgs) SELECT AVG(s.avg_usage) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(s.avg_usage - o.avg_usage) AS avg_difference FROM station_avgs AS s CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS o WHERE o.avg_usage IS NOT NULL AND s.avg_usage > o.avg_usage
